audit.why: 52.35% over 957 games: Fiora owns levels 1-5, it evens at 6 and first item, and a two-item Yasuo takes it. 6/10 with a 9/10 carry threat matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 were marked Skill though whys[3] says you keep him pinned; level 6 was marked Fiora though whys[4] says 'It is even at 6'; 2+ items was marked Fiora though whys[6] and late both hand it to Yasuo.
audit.corrected: win[3] to Fiora, win[4] to Skill, win[6] to Yasuo, with the full phases sides/ratings flipped as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two of the three do/don't bodies were generic filler, and the page never states which cooldown actually governs the knockup or how short Last Breath gets.
audit.why: Steel Tempest is a flat 4s and only knocks up on the second Gathering Storm stack — that stack, not the cast, is the tell. Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s and blocks projectiles for 4s, which is exactly nothing in Fiora's kit (Q dash, autos, Vitals). Last Breath is 70/50/30s, so by rank 3 it is up for almost every fight.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall stated in dosFull[1].d, the 2-stack knockup in dontsFull[1].d, and all three cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Last Breath' with no number, on a champion whose R hits 30s at rank 3.
audit.why: The advice 'engage when his R is down' quietly stops being available late; the page should say so.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now states 70s at rank 1 falling to 30s at rank 3.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Yasuo, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Wind Wall blocks projectiles for 4s — your Q, autos and Vitals are melee and walk straight through it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His 2nd Steel Tempest stack knocks up — count it, Q is a flat 4s.

edits.before: - Yasuo Last Breath: matchup-defining — His all-in after a knockup. While down, you win. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yasuo Last Breath: 70s at rank 1 but 30s at rank 3 — late it is up for every fight. - Steel Tempest: a flat 4s; the 2nd stack is the knockup. - Wind Wall: 25s, and it blocks nothing you do. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: The page's central claim — Wind Wall cannot stop Fiora — is correct from Riot's text (it blocks projectiles; Lunge is a dash-stab and Vitals are melee) and I strengthened rather than changed it. spikes[2]/whys[5] name Profane Hydra while report[8] names Ravenous Hydra: the same Fiora-wide build inconsistency, untouched.
